verify_detail: c component on the 3rd and 5th cold start of every 5-launch cycle since the last `pm clear`. A UI test that force-stops/reinstalls between runs but doesn\'t reset or pin this counter will hit the hidden-button state exactly 2 times out of every 5 runs, producing the reported "passes ~3/5" behavior. Fix: either reset `launchCount` (clear app data / reinstall) before each test run, or make the test assert against the counter-derived expected state instead of assuming the button is always present.'
